about: Every frozen decision rule in this repository adjudicated at the 0.65 bar or the 0.05 margin, one row per rule and run, as recorded at the time. No rule is re-adjudicated and no threshold is changed here. Each clause names the artifact value it reads; scripts/build_paper_tables.py recomputes every value, checks it against the recorded reading and the recorded outcome, and renders docs/RULE_LEDGER.md.
